title: QuantumIDEReleaseManifest
description: Defines the release manifest metadata for a specific Quantum IDE distribution channel and platform. Schema v2.0.0 adds mandatory commit, buildRevision, and optional Ed25519 signature fields.

schemaVersion.description: Semantic version of the manifest schema format (e.g., 2.0.0)

productName.description: Product brand identifier. Must equal 'Quantum IDE'. (Renamed from 'product' in schema v2.0.0 to match engine validation contract.)

installerType.description: Installer packaging format for Windows distribution

version.description: Release semver tag (e.g., 0.1.0-beta.1 or v0.1.0-beta.1 — leading v is stripped by the engine)

buildRevision.description: Monotonically increasing build number within a given version. Increments on every rebuild or CI run. Must be strictly greater than the previously deployed buildRevision for the same version.

commit.description: Full 40-character lowercase Git commit SHA of the source tree used to produce the installer. Used as build identity in Win32 versioned resources folder (first 10 chars).

updateClass.description: Classification governing how Quantum client consumes the update

publishedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of release publication

available.description: Indicates whether a verified installer asset is actively available for download

downloadUrl.description: Direct HTTPS URL to download the binary installer asset on GitHub Releases

fileName.description: Canonical filename of the installer asset (e.g., Quantum-IDE-0.1.0-beta.1-win-x64-setup.exe)

sizeBytes.description: Exact size of the installer asset in bytes

sha256.description: SHA-256 cryptographic digest of the installer file (hex, 64 chars)

releaseNotesUrl.description: URL to public release notes or changelog

signature.description: Base64-encoded Ed25519 signature over the RFC 8785 JCS canonical manifest (all fields except 'signature' itself, keys sorted recursively). Required for production distribution.

keyId.description: Identifier of the Ed25519 signing key used to produce the signature. 'quantum-update-v1-test' for development/test only; 'quantum-update-v1-prod' for production releases.

minOSVersion.description: Minimum supported operating system version (e.g., '10.0' for Windows 10)
